about: The tags every AWS resource of Secure Notes carries (docs/modernization/plan-tags-and-teardown.md). The workflow passes them to CloudFormation as stack tags; scripts/tags-check.py holds the templates to them on every push.

perDeploy.Environment: the template's Environment parameter (dev, uat, qa, prod); shared for the bootstrap stack
perDeploy.DeployedBy: github-actions, cli or console: the template's DeployedBy parameter

untaggableTypes.about: Resource types whose CloudFormation schema says taggable: false (cfn-lint 1.57.2's copy of the AWS resource schemas). Each is attached to a tagged parent, except AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate: it takes no Tags property, so it tags itself, its volumes and its network interfaces through TagSpecifications, which the check requires. A type that takes tags is covered by the stack tags; a type on neither side fails the check, so a new one gets reviewed.

taggableTypes.about: Resource types whose CloudFormation schema says taggable: true (same source). CloudFormation gives them the stack tags; the bootstrap template, deployed from the console, names its tags itself.
